systema.scientific_spec: official paper plus mlbio-epfl/systema revision aaf5b5353993b48b78543f2f93b3e18ca65df515

gse281160.consequence: Its MPRA-selected noncoding targets, guide responses, and expression profiles cannot support an unbiased or external claim. A fold-local model can be outcome-unexposed only to its held target groups.

gse275483.use: n=4 animal cross-species stress after activation
gse275483.consequence: Opening outcomes makes this exposed development evidence. No threshold, target mapping, ortholog rule, or model selection may then be repaired against the same animals.

gse313774.consequence: Commit the full prediction universe and predictions first. Outcome-derived scale mapping, intervention mapping, calibration, gene filtering, pathway selection, or model repair is prohibited.

Systema_leakage_finding.matching_mean: A baseline constructed from outer-training perturbation means. For unseen single-component targets it is the perturbed mean.
Systema_leakage_finding.strict_center: Subtract one outer-training perturbed centroid from both prediction and observation. The same fixed vector is used for all held rows.
Systema_leakage_finding.outcome_center: A center computed from evaluation outcomes is transductive evaluator state. It cannot be returned to the model or used for selection.
Systema_leakage_finding.not_a_correction: Centering does not remove batch, guide, context, composition, species, assay, target-selection, or confounding bias. It cannot legitimize a target prediction learned from held outcomes.

known_leakage_and_bias_routes: Computing pseudobulk, normalization, gene selection, centroids, target features, context encodings, regularization, or Systema references with held target outcomes.
Splitting guides from one target locus, cells from one experimental replicate, technical lanes from one sample, or libraries from one liver-chip batch across roles.
Treating cells, guides, targets, libraries, genes, or random seeds as biological replicates.
Using target IDs, nearest genes, linked genes, observed response embeddings, or post-outcome vocabulary extensions as held-noncoding-target features.
Subtracting a held-target centroid and describing the resulting correlation as prediction of a wholly unseen target.
Estimating the Systema center from held outcomes and feeding it into fitting, calibration, thresholding, model selection, or prediction repair.
Pooling raw counts, log expression, fold change, DE statistics, mouse ortholog summaries, single-cell pseudobulk, and bulk liver-chip profiles on one numerical axis.
Using GSE281160's MPRA-selected targets as an unbiased target sample.
Using one fasting mouse or three liver-chip batches to support a population treatment-response claim.
Selecting genes or pathways from the abstract-highlighted GSE313774 CXCL1 or IL8 results after outcome access.

pseudoreplication_disposition.gse281160: Experimental replicate is the inferential unit; target-locus pseudobulks remain nested outcomes. The replicate count must be resolved before fitting.
pseudoreplication_disposition.gse275483: Animal is the inferential unit, n=4. Cells and perturbation labels are nested within animal.
pseudoreplication_disposition.gse313774: Independent experimental batch is the inferential unit, n=3. The 33 libraries are nested condition measurements, not n=33.
pseudoreplication_disposition.uncertainty: Paired cluster bootstrap resamples the declared biological units 10000 times and preserves nested rows.

calibration_and_selection_disposition.future_calibration: Any categorical or probability endpoint requires a separately registered calibrator fit only on cross-fitted outer-training predictions.
calibration_and_selection_disposition.model_selection: All feature, scale, regularization, matching, and pathway choices are locked before development outcome scoring; GSE313774 forbids fit and selection.
calibration_and_selection_disposition.Systema_family: For the registered single-component task, Systema matching mean and perturbed_mean count once for family selection, multiplicity, complementarity, and evidence.

license_and_release_disposition.control_mean_perturbed_mean_ridge_biline: No upstream code or weights. Project code license remains unresolved because no implementation and no repository-root license have been admitted.
license_and_release_disposition.systema: No detected license for the exact official repository revision. Independently implement the paper equation without code reuse; do not redistribute upstream code.
license_and_release_disposition.fitted_state: Project-created centroids and coefficients are not third-party weights but remain subject to input-data and project output terms.
license_and_release_disposition.data_outputs: GEO-derived rows and predictions remain source-reference-only unless source-specific redistribution review permits more.
license_and_release_disposition.open_champion: ineligible_currently; source release also waits for project license and reproducibility receipts

remaining_blockers: Resolve GSE281160 experimental replicates, controls, custom reference and guide-feature crosswalk; GSE275483 reference and animal joins; and GSE313774 batch, condition, and gene identities.
Freeze assay-native response scales, gene axes, target/context feature manifests, missingness, control hierarchies, and cross-species or cross-assay mappings before fitting.
Implement the five formulas under immutable repo-local identities; do not reuse unlicensed Systema source code.
Freeze inner grouped folds, solver and numerical tolerance, the declared regularization grid, one-standard-error selection, coefficient formats, and resource estimate.

Pass approved CPU-SLURM fixtures for replicate-first pseudobulk, target and guide grouping, train-only transforms, deterministic centroids and linear fits, Systema single-target equivalence, missing-control failure, serialization, and output reproduction.
Commit GSE313774 genome-wide predictions before outcome access and retain the terminal result without model repair.
Keep all results exploratory and nonclinical until a separately registered and powered sealed perturbation source exists.
